test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the image that does NOT belong to the group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72a2a78fa45daa72aa35472830924366304408853bd53ca67dee0c67e86e5895.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** In figures **P, Q, and R**, the straight line inside the circle passes through the center, forming a **diameter**, which divides the circle into two equal halves. In figure **S**, the line does not pass through the center, forming a **chord**, which divides the circle into unequal parts. Hence, S does not follow the same rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72a2a78fa45daa72aa35472830924366304408853bd53ca67dee0c67e86e5895.png] 

Now, checking the Options:

Option 1: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ba4f1b93d0e6b8a5228c785565ba8c904cd5bccb519f5557c87d45d4fa995b9.png] 
Circle with line not passing through center – Chord → Breaks the rule → Odd one out

Option 2: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5828aaeb8b0feedd6977f57db7d4542bd7508536ac3551f43454ff9c444904a.png] 
Circle with line passing through center – Diameter → Follows the rule

Option 3: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5415fd28d22e0ec9360505716afea28a9aba7e18b1421e2463d7e4919c2fd8ca.png] 
Circle with line passing through center – Diameter → Follows the rule

**Option 4: ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7ab7268a97517e412d7edab972f536a94fb3ef84604bdefad8c61a52b326893.png] 

Circle with line passing through center – Diameter → Follows the rule

Hence, **Option 1** is the odd figure pair.
